scoring_justification: Full metric recompute (T1) is infeasible because the verifier cannot re-run the expensive Monte Carlo simulation. Scoring uses structural checks for transient currents and result-level comparison with paper-derived gold for velocity and responsivity (T0 acceptable).

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference values for peak velocity vs field (from Fig.4) and responsivity plateau magnitudes (from analytical estimate via eq.(7) and Fig.4).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper figures and text: vpeak values read approximately from Fig.4; responsivity values 0.05 and 0.06 A/W from text estimate.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Manual digitization of Fig.4 and analytical formula (7) with peak kinetic energy from same figure.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values trace to the paper's own reported Monte Carlo simulation results, ensuring the reference is faithful to the paper's claims.

outputs.description: Simulated transient photocurrent for AlGaAs/GaAs QWIP. The hidden check compares the presence of a sharp peak within 0.5 ps, peak current amplitude, and decay shape against the paper's Fig. 5 with ±20% tolerance.
Simulated transient photocurrent for InP/InGaAs QWIP. Checked similarly against Fig. 6.

Peak drift velocity vs electric field. The check verifies that vpeak_InP > vpeak_AlGaAs at each field and that the values fall within ±20% of the paper's gold values. Monotonic increase is also expected.

Frequency-dependent responsivity. The check compares the magnitude at selected frequencies (e.g., 1 THz, 3 THz) against the paper's gold values within ±30% tolerance, and verifies that |R(ω)| decays with frequency and that R_InP > R_AlGaAs in the THz range.

output_contract.notes: All outputs are scored by direct comparison to the paper-reported values (T0 result-level compare). Tolerances are specified per artifact. The process step s0 is required but not scored; its evidence file is optional.

steps.description: Verify AlGaAs transient current has a sharp peak within 0.5 ps and positive currents.
Verify InP transient current has a sharp peak within 0.5 ps and positive currents.
Check peak drift velocity vs field matches paper Fig.4 within ±20%, with InP > AlGaAs and monotonic increase.
Compare responsivity magnitude at 1 and 3 THz to paper plateau values (±30%), verify R_InP > R_AlGaAs and decay with frequency.
